closedDefects.defect: a finalization recorded BEFORE the observation it claims to close was accepted
closedDefects.correction: the window is derived from the durable record ORDER: an observation after the finalization is CONTRADICTORY

closedDefects.defect: a finalization whose observedCandidateCount disagreed with the actual candidate set was not detected
closedDefects.correction: the recorded count is compared to the ACTUAL distinct candidate set derived from the records

closedDefects.defect: the delegation collapsed close/exit/timeout/abort into one close reason
closedDefects.correction: the finalization vocabulary distinguishes INVOCATION_RETURNED from PARENT_TERMINATED from UNKNOWN, and an UNKNOWN reason leaves the window OPEN rather than CLOSED

whatItDoesNotClaim: it does not claim the IPC channel is drained; a finalization written after all observations is the strongest ordering a durable log can show, and that is exactly what is required
tests: P2C C2 §6.6 an observation after the finalization is CONTRADICTORY
P2C C2 §6.6 a candidate-count mismatch is CONTRADICTORY
P2C C2 §6.6 a finalization with no observation at all is CONTRADICTORY
P2C C2 §6.6 a consistent closed window is CLOSED_CONSISTENT
